author: TeIq
content:
**Scope.** Wire Polaris to the live ATProto firehose, persist reports + observations, and aggregate reports into incidents bound to subjects. Delivers the subject-centric case view (design.md §5.2). Maps to design.md §11 M1 and `.design/polaris-proto-blue-integration.md` REQ-8, AC-9.

**Children (4).** Firehose worker; Subject/Incident/Action/Report schema + repositories; subject-centric case API; Leptos case-view UI.

**Done when.** A running Polaris consumes the firehose with cursor persistence, ingests synthetic reports, aggregates them per subject, and a moderator can open a case in the UI and see the full state. AC-9 passes end-to-end.

**Rust-quality.**
- Async lifetimes: ingest tasks own their own connection pool handles; no `Arc<Mutex<Connection>>` shared across tasks.
- Backpressure: bounded channels between ingest and persistence with documented capacity choices.
- Idempotent inserts on every storage path — firehose replays must not duplicate rows.
